scope: Proposal board only; approved screen presentation and active mock behavior unchanged.
implementationStatus: F01/F02, A164 and A169 are implemented in the browser preview; 46 action proposals remain pending.

foundations.title: One account-scoped preview store
foundations.proposal: One top-level memory store keyed by account plus stable object IDs; saved records separate from per-form/per-record drafts. Device theme/language preferences stay separate. No new backend persistence is implied.
foundations.acceptance: Switching preview account cannot expose previous private records; refreshing a memory-only preview is labelled honestly.
foundations.implementation: Shared host memory, frame leases, draft/context capture and origin navigation are connected in the workflow preview. Dependent feature-specific gaps remain pending.

foundations.title: Shared navigation context
foundations.proposal: Carry origin screen, record ID, filter/search/scroll snapshot and draft key through existing destinations. Keep approved owner/helper navigation and modal dismissal patterns.
foundations.acceptance: Back restores the real origin and its draft rather than a hard-coded unrelated destination.
foundations.implementation: Shared host memory, frame leases, draft/context capture and origin navigation are connected in the workflow preview. Dependent feature-specific gaps remain pending.

proposals.proposedFix: Continue only after the current account’s email-confirmation state is verified. Reuse the existing email screen for pending/resend recovery; review any new expired-link presentation separately.
proposals.expected: An unconfirmed account stays on Email confirmation; confirmation resumes its own onboarding draft.
acceptance: Unconfirmed, confirmed and expired-link cases do not skip the gate.
Resend stays generic and does not reveal whether another account exists.
proposals.current: Fixture proceeds without real provider confirmation.

proposals.proposedFix: Connect the shared Nearby city picker to the bundled GeoNames directory and aliases. Keep the current picker layout and canonical city identity.
proposals.expected: Searching a Polish alias finds the same city ID as its local name, with country and region visible.
acceptance: No match offers the existing manual entry flow.
City selection remains separate from device location.
proposals.current: Filters four fixture cities; full GeoNames directory not connected.

proposals.proposedFix: Retain a country-qualified manual settlement key; never fabricate coordinates. Ask for a valid IANA zone only when the originating scheduling context requires it.
proposals.expected: A small settlement can be saved without pretending that its centre or time zone was resolved.
acceptance: Country is retained with the settlement name.
Meeting/helper scheduling cannot proceed with an invalid required zone.
proposals.current: Requires name and country; coordinate/zone lookup remains incomplete.

proposals.proposedFix: Product decision required: keep the cat-sitting preference informational without accepting cat-sitting bookings, or review a complete cat-sitting journey separately. Do not reuse walking completion semantics silently.
proposals.expected: The preference does not imply an operational cat-sitting service.
acceptance: No cat-sitting booking or completion path is introduced by this proposal.
A chosen scope is documented before its dependent flow is implemented.
proposals.current: Local service preference; cat-sitting lifecycle is not connected.

proposals.proposedFix: Use the existing unsaved-change confirmation. Proposed semantics: Continue editing retains the working draft; Discard returns to the origin with saved preferences unchanged. Do not add a third Keep draft action without separate review.
proposals.expected: Back from edited helper preferences does not silently save or lose changes.
acceptance: Continue editing restores every edited value.
Discard leaves saved preferences unchanged and returns to the initiating request/list.
proposals.current: Needs approved draft/exit behavior.

proposals.proposedFix: On explicit confirmation, create one application keyed by account and request. Return to the same request with the existing sent toast/pending context; no agreement chat yet.
proposals.expected: Confirming once makes that request show the actor’s pending application.
acceptance: Double confirmation cannot create duplicates.
The application stays separate from upcoming assigned agreements.
proposals.current: Closes compact confirmation and shows status toast on the request; application record still missing.

proposals.proposedFix: Use the same reviewed exit policy as helper preferences: closing an unchanged editor returns directly; a dirty editor asks Continue editing or Discard. Keep working and saved identity separate.
proposals.expected: Cancel never replaces saved profile values with partial edits.
acceptance: Continue editing retains name, photo and city draft.
Discard restores saved identity across profile and other previews.
proposals.current: Returns to profile; cross-frame draft safety needs verification.

proposals.proposedFix: Store pets by account and stable pet ID. Add appends; Edit updates only the selected pet. Keep the existing pet form and origin-specific return destination.
proposals.expected: Adding a second pet preserves the first; editing its habits changes only that pet.
acceptance: Add and Edit use distinct record operations.
Cancel creates no pet and leaves saved photos/fields unchanged.
proposals.current: Replaces one pet fixture rather than maintaining a collection.

proposals.proposedFix: Open the existing pet editor with the selected pet ID and habits section context; save back to that pet’s detail view. Preserve the existing detail/editor layouts.
proposals.expected: Edit habits from Персик never edits another pet or an unrelated default fixture.
acceptance: Back/cancel returns to the same pet.
Save updates the selected pet’s habits in detail and profile.
proposals.current: Existing habits editor; full pet form route needs consolidation.

proposals.proposedFix: Keep the browser permission/unavailable preview honest. Native verification is separate: request location explicitly, preserve a manual city until the user chooses Nearby, and publish no GPS.
proposals.expected: Denying location keeps city selection usable; selecting Nearby is an explicit mode change.
acceptance: Denied and unavailable location retain manual selection.
No background tracking or silent GPS publication.
proposals.current: Permission preview; real service not configured.

proposals.proposedFix: Retain the unavailable-map fallback until a configured renderer is verified. Verify gestures in inline/fullscreen and zoom/location controls only in fullscreen, after free-tier account controls are checked.
proposals.expected: The mock never pretends that sample points are a functioning map renderer.
acceptance: Fallback list remains reachable when the renderer fails.
No paid usage or new token/account connection is authorized by approving this proposal.
proposals.current: No configured renderer; native verification required.

proposals.proposedFix: Use one account-scoped favorite-ID set for place list, detail and personal profile; retain existing favorite controls and profile rows.
proposals.expected: Favoriting a place makes the same place appear inline in the profile.
acceptance: Unfavorite updates all three surfaces.
Account switching does not leak another account’s favorite set.
proposals.current: Local reference memory; profile favorites are not synchronized.

proposals.proposedFix: Open or reuse a direct thread keyed by both account IDs, using the approved direct-chat design and shared inbox. Carry the People origin for Back.
proposals.expected: Chat from a person card opens that person, and the thread appears once in Chats.
acceptance: Two people with the same display name remain distinct.
Draft and back-to-People context survive a round trip.
proposals.current: Opens reference conversation, separate from shell inbox.

proposals.proposedFix: Connect the community’s exact conversation ID and membership to the shared inbox. Nonmembers use the existing voluntary Join action; opening a public community never joins it automatically.
proposals.expected: A joined member sees the same community thread from details and Chats.
acceptance: Nonmember entry does not grant chat access.
Leaving invalidates participant access while public details remain discoverable.
proposals.current: Reference chat exists; shell inbox membership is not shared.

proposals.proposedFix: Copy a stable public community link and resolve it visibly to the existing invitation/community preview. Unknown links use the approved unavailable view; no automatic membership.
proposals.expected: A fresh recipient opens the named community and explicitly chooses Join.
acceptance: Copied link resolves the same community ID in a fresh context.
Missing links never fall back to a different community.
proposals.current: Copies fixture URL; fresh link resolution targets a hidden preview.

proposals.proposedFix: Create a group with stable ID, creator ownership and membership in the account-scoped preview store; show it in community list/details and its shared conversation. Keep browser lifetime memory-only.
proposals.expected: A created group stays consistent while navigating in the same preview session.
acceptance: Owner capability is checked; product role is not an admin role.
Reload/reset does not claim server persistence; a different account has no creator privileges.
proposals.current: Adds local fixture group; owner/refresh/account isolation incomplete.

proposals.proposedFix: Make all New request entry points check owner capability and the owned-pet collection. No pet uses the existing inline notice and pet form, then resumes the unsent request draft.
proposals.expected: An owner with no pet adds one and returns to the same request form.
acceptance: Cancel pet creation returns without publishing a request.
An owner with pets selects by pet ID; helper-only mode cannot create.
proposals.current: Existing direct form bypasses no-pet prerequisite.

proposals.proposedFix: Open the selected agreement’s participant conversation in the approved walking chat. Use the same record in the shell inbox; retain list filters and scroll origin.
proposals.expected: Agreement chat from Current opens the assigned owner/helper and correct pet.
acceptance: Unassigned applications cannot open this chat.
Opening another agreement does not reuse the first agreement’s status or messages.
proposals.current: Frozen conversation preview; not shared with shell inbox.

proposals.proposedFix: Route each bottom-navigation item to its selected approved destination rather than a fixture notice. Preserve owner/helper destination sets and each section’s search/filter/scroll snapshot.
proposals.expected: Selecting Chats opens Chats; returning to Walking restores the prior list state.
acceptance: All five owner and four helper destinations route by key, not translated label.
The current marker matches the visible section after Back and mode change.
proposals.current: Frozen walking navigation still displays notices instead of routing.

proposals.proposedFix: Apply the existing date-filter draft only on Apply, evaluating each walking record in that walk city’s IANA zone. Keep the current filter presentation.
proposals.expected: A walk near midnight is included according to its own city date, not the device date.
acceptance: Today/range boundaries are verified across two venue zones and a DST boundary.
Close discards changes; Reset edits only the working filter.
proposals.current: Fixture date range; city-zone semantics need verification.

proposals.proposedFix: Open the selected scheduled/completed agreement’s same participant thread, carrying the detail origin for Back. Completion does not create a second thread.
proposals.expected: Chat from either agreement detail shows that agreement’s history and returns to the same record.
acceptance: Scheduled and completed views resolve by agreement ID.
Private handover details remain restricted to agreement participants.
proposals.current: Opens isolated walking chat preview.

proposals.proposedFix: Supersede the older direct-detail advancement proposal. Details stay informational; lifecycle actions open the existing fixed status entry and compact controls in the participant chat. Store state by agreement and actor.
proposals.expected: Only the assigned helper starts/finishes; only the owner confirms that selected agreement.
acceptance: Advancing one agreement leaves all others unchanged.
No automatic completion, tracking or elapsed-time-triggered transition.
proposals.current: Changes shared view status; not agreement-scoped.

proposals.proposedFix: Do not offer a review for a scheduled agreement. Only owner-confirmed completion enables the existing direction-specific review action in chat/history.
proposals.expected: A scheduled record cannot reach a writable review form through a direct link.
acceptance: Eligibility is checked from agreement, actor and completion state.
Helper and owner review directions remain independent.
proposals.current: A scheduled agreement is not reviewable. Owner-confirmed completion must establish eligibility before opening the review form.

proposals.proposedFix: Open the selected scheduled/completed agreement’s same participant thread, carrying the detail origin for Back. Completion does not create a second thread.
proposals.expected: Chat from either agreement detail shows that agreement’s history and returns to the same record.
acceptance: Scheduled and completed views resolve by agreement ID.
Private handover details remain restricted to agreement participants.
proposals.current: Opens isolated walking chat preview.

proposals.proposedFix: Supersede the stale completed-to-scheduled target: completed details must not advance or restart an agreement. Link only to its existing completed chat/status/review context, subject to eligibility.
proposals.expected: Opening a completed agreement cannot move it back to Scheduled.
acceptance: No Start/Finish/Confirm mutation is offered after completion.
Duplicate completion requests do not create a second history entry.
proposals.current: Changes shared view status; not agreement-scoped.

proposals.proposedFix: Compute Leave review eligibility from completed agreement ID, author ID and owner/helper direction; route to the matching existing review design.
proposals.expected: Owner and helper each see only their own eligible review action.
acceptance: Existing review opens in edit/read context instead of adding a duplicate.
Role switching does not erase earned eligibility.
proposals.current: Eligibility uses fixture-wide flags rather than agreement/direction.

proposals.proposedFix: Confirm the selected applicant for one request and assign atomically in the eventual authoritative implementation. The local preview must reject conflicting assignment and create one participant agreement.
proposals.expected: Choosing Ульяна assigns her to the selected request and opens that agreement’s chat.
acceptance: Double selection or two competing applicants cannot create two assignments.
Other requests and unassigned applications remain unchanged.
proposals.current: Three selectable local applicants; selected identity follows the conversation preview. Atomic assignment remains missing. Review 26 supplies the destination design; runtime object/state wiring remains a gap.

proposals.proposedFix: Reuse the existing withdrawal confirmation for the actor’s exact unassigned application. Cancel retains it; confirm withdraws only that application and restores request/list context.
proposals.expected: Withdrawing from request A does not remove an application to request B.
acceptance: Already assigned requests do not use this withdrawal path.
Pending context and filtered lists update together after confirmation.
proposals.current: Missing approved connected action/confirmation. Review 26 supplies the destination design; runtime object/state wiring remains a gap.

proposals.proposedFix: Reuse the isolated report design with selected review ID and report reason. Acknowledgment confirms receipt only; reporting does not auto-delete or invent a moderator workflow.
proposals.expected: Report from a walking review stays associated with that review and returns to its list.
acceptance: Private addresses/instructions are not copied into public report text.
Removal thresholds and handling policy remain separate unresolved work.
proposals.current: No complete active report flow. Review 26 supplies the destination design; runtime object/state wiring remains a gap.

proposals.proposedFix: Submit one eligible review per agreement/direction; derive role-specific preview aggregates from eligible published review records. Production totals remain server-controlled.
proposals.expected: A completed owner review updates the helper’s rating/count, not place or owner reputation.
acceptance: Duplicate submit is idempotent; no self-review or unrelated account review.
Zero eligible reviews shows No reviews yet; role changes preserve eligibility.
proposals.current: Fixture-wide reviewed flag; counts and per-agreement uniqueness incomplete.

proposals.proposedFix: Attach the reply to the selected review ID and entitled recipient role. Persist it in the shared memory record and return to that review without changing its rating.
proposals.expected: Replying to one helper review appears under that review only.
acceptance: Other reviews and role aggregates remain unchanged.
Account/role changes cannot grant arbitrary reply permission.
proposals.current: Local reply flag; review-specific thread not shared.

proposals.proposedFix: Replace the generic notice route with a resolver for the selected conversation type and stable ID: direct, community, meeting or walking. Reuse existing chat designs; retain a recovery view for unknown/inaccessible threads.
proposals.expected: An inbox row opens its own participants, messages and context.
acceptance: Unknown IDs never fall back to a default person/thread.
A draft and scroll position belong to the correct thread and account.
proposals.current: Shows generic conversation notice.
proposals.reviewStatus: Implemented in Review 46 · browser preview only
proposals.implementation: Stable conversation IDs select existing chat layouts; account-scoped composer drafts and inbox origin context survive Back. Unknown or inaccessible IDs open recovery.

proposals.proposedFix: Wire person search to the existing picker results using public account IDs, with the existing no-match presentation. Keep search local in the preview.
proposals.expected: Typing a name filters the selectable public-person list.
acceptance: Clearing search restores results.
No matches does not substitute another person or reveal private profile fields.
proposals.current: Search input is not wired to results.

proposals.proposedFix: Select a person by stable account ID and open/reuse the approved direct thread in the shared inbox. Do not send a message until explicit Send.
proposals.expected: Selecting a person opens a composer for that person without sending or duplicating a thread.
acceptance: Cancel keeps the inbox unchanged.
A matching existing direct thread is reused.
proposals.current: Shows shell notice instead of approved conversation.

proposals.proposedFix: Append a sent message to the selected direct conversation and shared inbox record, with sender/time and a per-thread draft. Send remains explicit; preserve photos-only constraints.
proposals.expected: A message sent in direct chat appears in that same inbox conversation preview.
acceptance: Switching threads keeps unsent drafts separate.
No send occurs from merely opening a thread or attaching a photo.
proposals.current: Approved isolated reference composer; messages do not share account inbox.
proposals.reviewStatus: Implemented in Review 47 · browser preview only
proposals.implementation: Explicit direct text Send resolves account membership/access again, appends once, updates the inbox last-message/time/order and clears only the sent thread draft. Blank/oversized sends do not mutate state. Other thread and form drafts, inbox context and origin navigation remain intact.

proposals.proposedFix: Reuse the existing report sheet for the exact conversation/message and author account. Receipt acknowledgment is separate from blocking; do not infer blocked access, auto-removal or a moderation threshold.
proposals.expected: Reporting from the current chat returns to that same conversation; its target cannot change during sheet navigation.
acceptance: Report target, reason and return context survive a round trip.
Reporting alone does not block the person or erase the thread.
proposals.current: Design reference exists; candidate submission/blocked access not connected. Review 26 supplies the destination design; runtime object/state wiring remains a gap.

proposals.proposedFix: Use an origin-aware Back stack: return to the initiating person/community/agreement detail when applicable, otherwise Chats. Preserve the thread draft and initiating list state.
proposals.expected: Back from a chat opened in People returns to People; an inbox-opened chat returns to Chats.
acceptance: Do not implement Back as a hard-coded redirect to an unrelated list.
Current module marker, search, filters and scroll are restored.
proposals.current: Needs shared conversation/inbox routing.

proposals.proposedFix: Append messages to the exact community thread only for an active member; update the same inbox record. Keep the approved group conversation layout.
proposals.expected: Sending in one community updates that community’s preview without crossing into a direct thread.
acceptance: Membership loss prevents new sends.
Sender/time, drafts and photo limits stay intact.
proposals.current: Approved isolated reference composer; messages do not share account inbox.

proposals.expected: Owner/helper see the same agreement conversation across entry points.
acceptance: Only the two authorized participants can send/read private handover context.

proposals.proposedFix: Share System/Light/Dark preference across shell, maps, overlays and child references. Persist the explicit device-local choice, resolving System from current device appearance.
proposals.expected: Changing theme updates all active surfaces without resetting the current form draft.
acceptance: A nested picker uses the same theme as its parent.
System reacts to appearance changes; explicit Light/Dark remains stable.
proposals.current: Changes local fixture theme; cross-frame propagation needs verification.

proposals.proposedFix: Connect Device/RU/EN/BE/PL to shared application-copy localization and locale formatting across frames. Preserve user content, canonical IDs and venue zones; persist only the device-local choice.
proposals.expected: Language changes update controls and dates without translating a person’s name/message.
acceptance: Device fallback is Russian when unsupported.
Long Polish/Cyrillic labels and 200% text wrap without losing selected values.
proposals.current: Selection label only; shell remains untranslated.

proposals.proposedFix: After the existing sign-out confirmation, tear down account-scoped private preview state, drafts and subscriptions, then show the approved sign-in screen. Retain only agreed device preferences.
proposals.expected: The next test account cannot read the previous account’s chat or private draft.
acceptance: Cancel does not sign out.
Back cannot resurrect an authenticated private preview; production session revocation needs separate native/server verification.
proposals.current: Current fixture only closes sheet; no session/draft teardown. Review 26 supplies the destination design; runtime object/state wiring remains a gap.

proposals.proposedFix: Resolve each activity item by object type and stable object ID to the existing meeting, chat or request design. Unknown/inaccessible targets use the existing recovery view.
proposals.expected: A chat notification opens its thread; a meeting activity opens that meeting, not a default lake fixture.
acceptance: Deleted/inaccessible targets do not fall back to a different object.
Return restores activity scroll/context without joining an event.
proposals.current: Context-specific notices/details; not every target connected.

proposals.proposedFix: Validate the existing form and create one owner/request record in the account-scoped preview store. Preserve selected pet ID, venue-zone time and private handover fields; show its card on return.
proposals.expected: Publish adds the owner’s new request to Current rather than just closing the form.
acceptance: Invalid/failed save retains the complete unsent draft.
Repeated confirmation creates one request; private care text stays participant-only.
proposals.current: Acknowledges local form without adding a persistent request to the list.
